expected: I see at most 20 orders per page and a link to the next page

title: Behaviour at 20 orders (maximum)
steps:
1. Set up data so the scenario involves 20 orders
2. I open "My orders"
expected: The rule holds exactly at the limit

title: Behaviour at 21 orders (above maximum 20)

2. I open "My orders"

title: Verify I see an "Access denied" message and no order details
preconditions: I am logged in as one customer

expected: I see an "Access denied" message and no order details

title: Rule is enforced: Another customer's order is not visible
steps:
1. Go to the 'View order history' journey
2. Attempt the action the rule forbids

title: Changing the record id in the URL does not expose another customer's data
steps:
1. Log in as customer A
2. Open a URL containing customer B's record id
expected: Access is denied and no data belonging to customer B is shown
